articles.body: As EU leaders meet for an AI summit in Dublin, largely overshadowed by Russia's war on Ukraine, William Hilderbrandt is pleased to welcome Fabrice Pothier, CEO of Rasmussen Global. On AI, Pothier points to Europe's limited computing capacity, estimating that it barely represents "5% of what's available out there." Despite the EU's wealth of researchers and expertise, he warns that Europe is struggling to turn these resources into "real technological and industrial scale." Now, turning to the war in Ukraine, Pothier argues that European governments should focus less on "whether they have a place at the table" and more on "making Ukraine's hands stronger," particularly by providing additional air defence interceptors.

articles.body: FRIENDS WITH (SNAP) BENEFITS: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani unveiled the latest perk of his chummy relationship with President Donald Trump, announcing a deal today that will give stores across the country more time to comply with changes to federal food assistance rules. New rules from the Department of Agriculture, which took effect last week, required retailers to stock a greater diversity of products in order to continue receiving SNAP benefits. Just before they kicked in, Mamdani signed onto a bipartisan letter to USDA Secretary Brooke Rollins urging the Trump administration to delay implementing the new requirements. He warned the rules would threaten the viability of the city’s more than 10,000 bodegas and corner stores, as well as the New Yorkers who rely on them, if the stores could not meet the mandates in time and lost the ability to accept SNAP payments. Now, after negotiations with Rollins and foe-turned-bro Trump, Mamdani secured a 90-day extension for small retailers to comply with the rules — not just in New York City, but nationwide. The extension starts Friday. Mamdani said he personally escalated the extension request to President Trump after City Hall reached out to the federal government. “What I told the president was that this is a rule that, if allowed to be implemented on the timeline as it was scheduled, would be one that would throw the lives of so many working New Yorkers into a real place of anxiety and chaos,” he said. “And the president took that concern seriously.” Mamdani declined to share how often he chats with Trump — “I’ll keep the cadence of that between the two of us,” he said — but he emphasized their conversations are ongoing. As the two executives approach the one-year anniversary of their unexpected bromance, today’s announcement serves as a reminder that Mamdani’s Trump strategy has largely paid off. After a seemingly love-struck Trump emerged from the duo’s first Oval Office meeting on Nov. 21, the threat of an immigration enforcement surge on par with Minneapolis largely evaporated, eliminating a potentially explosive situation that at the time loomed over the mayor’s early days in office. In February, Mamdani successfully petitioned Trump to release a Columbia University student who had been taken into the custody by U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement and, as POLITICO reported this week , Mamdani has continued to make those requests privately to the president. The two have also discussed the federal government’s involvement in a massive development project that would span the Sunnyside Yard rail depot in Queens. The price for these spoils has so far been one Mamdani’s base is willing to accept. The mayor rarely, if ever, criticizes Trump directly. He demurs when asked by reporters about their private phone calls. And during a joint appearance outside Gracie Mansion in late September, when asked about Trump’s short-lived White House media ban, Mamdani only said that he himself supported having a variety of news outlets covering City Hall. — Molly Reinmann and Joe Anuta From the Capitol NVIDIA AND BEYOND: Gov. Kathy Hochul isn’t worried that the scandal engulfing former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang will impact the broader semiconductor sector. “It’s a resilient industry,” she said today. “We’ve already planted the flag in places from Malta and all the way to Syracuse. New York’s economy will continue to be sound and continue to grow. This will not have an effect on meeting our obligations to continue the investments and create more jobs.” New York has placed a massive, long-term bet on the industry, which has toeholds in the Syracuse area and the Saratoga County town of Malta, where Hochul appeared today to tout the groundbreaking of a new chip manufacturing facility. Huang resigned amid allegations of multiple affairs, including a relationship with a woman who may be a potential Chinese spy . The tech boom has helped lift Wall Street and swell New York’s coffers. A slowdown may spell trouble for the economy. — Nick Reisman  LEADERSHIP MOVES: State Sen. Liz Krueger told Playbook today she isn’t angling to chair the body’s housing committee. “I’m not going to be the housing chair and I’m not lobbying to be the housing chair,” the Manhattan lawmaker said. “Several other people have voiced active interest and I think that’s great.” “I actually think that whoever is willing to be the housing chair should recognize they need to probably make a six-year commitment to this assignment,” she added. “And I’m not actually planning necessarily to make an additional six-year commitment to the Senate.” One member who has voiced interest in the role is state Sen. Julia Salazar, a democratic socialist who represents north Brooklyn. The committee is currently chaired by outgoing state Sen. Brian Kavanagh. “I’m a huge Julia Salazar fan,” Krueger said. “I think she’s an underestimated young talent in the Senate.” Decisions on chairmanships will be up to Majority Leader Andrea Stewart-Cousins, as the Senate navigates leadership turnover and the largest Democratic majority in 150 years. Krueger has chaired the Senate finance committee since Democrats took control of the chamber in 2019. She suffered a stroke earlier this year but has recovered and was recently elected to serve another full term. “The finance committee has about three times the workload of any committee,” Krueger noted. “I have told Andrea if she would like me to stay on in finance, I would be happy to do so, but I would need some kind of vice-chair or co-chair arrangement.” She added: “If nobody wants to give me any chairmanships because we have too many mouths to feed, that’s okay also. This will be my 25th year [in the senate]. I feel like people either know who I am and respect what I try to do or not, and it’s irrelevant what the title is on my door.” — Janaki Chadha FROM CITY HALL HE’S NO SCHU-IN: Mamdani pointedly declined to back Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer’s bid to continue leading the caucus when asked about it at a press conference this morning. “The American people made their voices very clear. They sent a message that they want Democratic leadership across the board that will deliver material improvements for the working class. And as the mayor of New York City, that's exactly what I want to see for New Yorkers across our five boroughs,” Mamdani said. “So I care less about who it is, and I care more about what they do.” Schumer is facing a leadership challenge from Maryland Sen. Chris Van Hollen, who has the support of Mamdani allies like Sen. Bernie Sanders of Vermont and Sen.-elect Abdul El-Sayed of Michigan. Mamdani’s hand-off approach to the Senate leadership race stands in stark contrast to the House, where the mayor has backed Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries’ bid to become speaker. — Joe Anuta JOGGER PROBE: The New York City Law Department is launching an independent review of the school system’s hiring and background check procedures following revelations that the suspect in the recent high-profile murder of a Brooklyn jogger had worked at an elementary school. At the request of schools Chancellor Kamar Samuels, the Law Department will conduct a review that will include an examination of employee screenings and verifications, how information is shared between government agencies and what safeguards are in place after an individual is hired. “The Law Department stands ready to conduct a review, follow the facts, and make recommendations based on what we find in order to make sure New York City Public Schools, and all collaborating agencies, continue to take all necessary measures to ensure the safety and well-being of students and staff,” Corporation Counsel Steven Banks said in a statement. Details of the review and the full scope are currently being developed, according to the Department of Education. Read more in POLITICO Pro from Madina Touré ULRICH TRIAL LATEST : As former New York City Correction Department Commissioner Louis Molina took the stand today in the trial of former Buildings Department Commissioner Eric Ulrich, a series of wiretapped calls and emails gave a behind-the-scenes peek at how patronage works within municipal government. Manhattan District Attorney Alvin Bragg has accused Ulrich of using his position as a senior adviser to former Mayor Eric Adams to obtain perks like cash payments and season tickets to the Mets. The former Queens City Council member has pleaded not guilty and is in the midst of a bench trial in Manhattan criminal court. As part of the case, prosecutors summoned Molina to the stand today to discuss how exactly the daughter of Ulrich’s close friend came to be hired as a policy analyst at the Department of Correction. “In my mind, it was her job if she wanted it,” Molina told Assistant District Attorney Guy Tardanico at one point during the proceedings. Shortly after Adams took office in 2022, Ulrich came to Molina with a candidate for open positions at the department. He impressed upon the correction commissioner that the candidate’s father, Michael Mazzio, who is on trial alongside Ulrich, was a friend of the mayor and that hiring his daughter was a top priority. Molina said that context spurred him to give her an interview and offer her a job — something that might not have happened had she applied via traditional routes. Defense attorneys for Ulrich and Mazzio, however, cross examined Molina and sought to show that recommendations for jobs from senior City Hall staffers were nothing out of the ordinary. And those attorneys noted that Ulrich never demanded Mazzio’s daughter be hired, nor complained when she was given an entry-level position instead of a loftier job title that came with a six-figure salary. — Joe Anuta FROM THE CAMPAIGN TRAIL HAKEEM’S HECKLERS: House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries took a victory lap today at the Majority Democrats’ confab in Denver. The welcome he received wasn’t entirely warm. Right after moderator Jessica Tarlov’s first question, protesters interrupted with demands that Jeffries support the Green New Deal, Medicare for All and an arms embargo against Israel. Tarlov then asked for his response to the criticism that his “leadership is too timid for the moment.” “As House Democrats, we're honored by the trust that the American people have placed in us to get the job done, and so we’ve got to work hard to deliver,” he replied. That didn’t quiet the hecklers. As Jeffries spoke about reversing Medicaid cuts and working to extend the Affordable Care Act tax credit, one tarred him as a “fucking liar.” “I'm from Brooklyn,” Jeffries said in response. “This is light work.” During the talk, he said he’s “absolutely a yes” on banning mid-cycle redistricting and partisan gerrymandering. “I said this when this all started in Texas last July, that Republicans and MAGA extremists started this redistricting war,” he said. “We're going to end it. And last Tuesday, that's what we did, decisively all across the country. So we're not going to unilaterally disarm, but at the same period of time, as we've done in two prior Congresses, we need to ban mid-decade gerrymandering and partisan gerrymandering.” New York Democrats are still mulling a mid-decade redistricting effort. — Madison Fernandez IN OTHER NEWS — DOWN WITH THE DSA: Veteran campaign strategist Hank Sheinkopf is repurposing his super PAC to block the DSA’s expansion in New York. articles.body: Democrats’ long-warring ideological factions have reached a détente, new POLITICO Poll data shows . It may not last. Half of progressives and moderates now say the party is “somewhat” or “much more” unified since the election, according to the latest survey, conducted last weekend by PF Global. And everyone agrees on what the Democratic-led Congress needs to do first, above anything else: bring down the cost of living. The size and sweep of Democrats’ midterms romp appears to have temporarily quelled the electability questions that fueled the long-running standoff between the party’s factions. Progressives flipped House districts and snagged Senate seats on plainly purple turf. Many moderate candidates flipped deep-red territory for the first time in decades. Put together, Democrats are now headed for their biggest House majority of the century. “We’ve got this great big-tent party that’s coming into Congress, and I think that’s what people want,” said Pete Giangreco, a veteran Democratic strategist who worked across House, Senate and gubernatorial races this past cycle. “They don’t want these ideological divisions” Today, two out of three Democratic midterm voters believe that progressives make their party stronger — considerably higher than the 41% who said so before Election Day, according to polls taken before and after the midterms. Among self-described moderate Democrats, that belief has risen 26 points, from 33% to 59%. Among progressives, it’s risen from 58% to 74%. “If people are spending more time going after other Democrats instead of figuring out how to work together as a team, then I'm not sure that they've got the right priorities,” moderate Sen. Elissa Slotkin (D-Mich.) told POLITICO. But it’s not clear how long the unity will last. The polling reveals cracks are already starting to reemerge within Democrats’ coalition, foreshadowing potential intraparty fights to come on Capitol Hill and beyond into 2028. Democrats agree on the broad strokes of their priorities, but they diverge on the scope of lawmakers’ approach and the kind of presidential nominee they’d like to see. “Democrats, they don’t need to be getting too big-headed about this quote-unquote blue wave or blue tsunami,” said incoming Arizona 6th District Rep. JoAnna Mendoza. “What they need to focus on is making sure that we’re bringing people relief and that we’re taking action because that’s what people need right now.” The poll bears out two of Democrats’ near-universal takeaways from last Tuesday that are already shaping the shadow 2028 presidential primary: Voters want to elect fighters — and they want them to cut down high costs. The overwhelming majority of Democratic midterm voters — 78% — say bringing down the cost of living should be Democrats’ top focus as they come into control of Congress next year. Nearly as many, 71%, of Americans said the same. But Democratic voters internally disagree on approach. The POLITICO Poll data shows 47% of the party’s midterm voters prefer the next Congress’ agenda be set by Democrats who want major systemic reforms and government intervention to reduce inequality, compared to 39% who prefer Democrats who want pragmatic and targeted economic solutions. A majority of progressives, 57%, choose systemic reform. Moderates, meanwhile, are split between systemic reform (43%) and targeted economic solutions (44%) Those splits are poised to spill onto the presidential campaign trail. Even as voters broadly agree on wanting a “fighter” candidate, half of progressives still think someone with their ideology would be among the most electable in 2028, while just over a third of moderates, 36%, say someone in their lane has the best shot. Several possible White House aspirants are trying to push a public truce, arguing that factional infighting needs to take a backseat for now . "I don't think any voters think about it that way," Pennsylvania Gov. Josh Shapiro told reporters when asked by POLITICO whether there was a progressive or moderate takeaway from the midterms at Crooked Media's post-election conference in D.C. "People want to see the results of their government because whether you voted for Trump or Harris in the last election, your prices are still too damn high." Progressive Rep. Ro Khanna, in a post-election interview, said “we had electability across the board” in the midterms and that the question heading into 2028 is “who has the best vision for America.” Lauren Fedor contributed to this report.

articles.body: You know you’ve made a good ad when it’s outperforming an endorsement video from Barack Obama. Ryan Sayles, a 27-year-old Mississippi content creator, is behind arguably the best political spot of the election cycle: Democrat Scott Colom’s viral “ pick another protein ” ad against GOP Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith. You’ve probably seen it by now. The ad featured Mississippi voters’ blunt reactions to Hyde-Smith’s suggestion that people struggling with rising beef prices choose from other protein options. “Pick another protein? Shiiii-, I’d rather pick another senator instead.” “Pick another protein? She done lost her damn mind. I’d rather pick another senator.” Sayles was at his nephew’s football game when he realized something extraordinary was happening. “I was looking at the first numbers when it first dropped, and I was like, ‘Oh, this is about to be a really good video,’” he told POLITICO after Colom’s historic Senate race victory in the longtime Republican stronghold. “We had the Obama endorsement the day before, so that was our biggest video. It was like, ‘Dang, we ain’t ever gonna top that.’” “And then this ad came, and we posted it, and it outperformed anything we ever did,” Sayles said. The 30-second spot quickly became the talk of Mississippi and Washington, helping fuel Colom’s longshot campaign to unseat Hyde-Smith and become the first Black senator from the state since Reconstruction. And, it’s given Democrats across the country another blueprint for how to break through online ahead of a critical 2028 presidential race, as the party continues to rethink its strategy. With the ad — and Colom’s win — Sayles has gone from a newcomer who stumbled into campaigning almost by accident to a name to watch in Democratic digital politics, as the party looks for fresh ways to reach voters ahead of 2028. “[Sayles] should be considered the breakout-star of this cycle,” Colom wrote in a post on X about the viral ad earlier this month. “He’s going to be a giant in the media consultant game. He did GAME CHANGING work with SO little.” In an interview with POLITICO, Sayles described how his lack of prior political experience shaped his approach to creating the ad and why he thinks Democrats should listen more closely to the voters they’re trying to reach. He also discussed the unexpected attention he’s received since the ad — and why he hopes Colom’s victory will serve as a wake-up call for the party to invest in the South. This interview has been edited for length and clarity.  How did you get involved with the Colom campaign?  I did a lot of freelance videography and photography, and they really just needed a photographer for one event they were doing back in October. And I came and did video and pictures for him, and they kept me around. They were like, "Yeah, we need to work with him,” and then from then on, I never left. Take me behind the scenes of creating the protein ad. How did it come together?  Scott and his brother, Andrew, along with [the] campaign manager Gerard, they all plotted the script together, and so they presented it to me. We filmed it, and I directed and made sure it [felt] like Mississippi. I guess I made it more Mississippi than what it was at the beginning. You know, [I] just added the entertainment or funny pieces of it, like emphasizing the way he said the words and stuff like that. And then I shot it, edited it, and added the music to it. I sat there and edited for like five hours. I've heard that man say “shit” a million times. Did you think it was going to go this viral?  I had high hopes for it, but I just didn't know what it could do. A lot of our content was getting around Mississippi, but it wasn't getting around the country. Mississippians knew about Scott Colom’s content and what he was doing, but it wasn't nationwide — and I think that ad really put a national focus on what was brewing in Mississippi. Why do you think this particular ad took off so much and felt so natural?  I think the reason it did well nationally is because I think a lot of people are fed up. A lot of times we don't express the way we feel, we hold it in, but I think this ad was an expression that people felt all around the country, that we just had the guts to put it out there. For Mississippi, of course it resonated because that's something we say down here. People say “shiiiit” all the time — like you know, that's the normal conversation. I think the best thing about the ad was it was centering people, centering voters ... You know, Scott was in the ad for about five seconds, but then that was the biggest ad of the cycle. I think it was just a lesson that people matter way more than politics. Did anybody worry the ad went too far? Do you think Democrats are sometimes too cautious?  I think the dope part is, we didn't run that ad by anybody. … We didn’t go around getting OK’s from anybody ... we just put it out. But also … I've never worked on a campaign, and I think that I didn't have a sense of what Dems normally did. You know what I mean? We just did what we liked, and that was one of the big things Scott always talked about. “Man, if we are good with the content, we are good.” Scott is the best person I could’ve been in this situation with. He has been such a great person. He’s so creative, and he has allowed me to shine in ways that I just can’t believe. Did you hear from people in the Democratic Party after the ad came out? Like I said, this is my first campaign, so this is all a blur right now, honestly. But I would say that I've gotten messages, a lot of messages. I don't know who all those messages are tied to at this point, but I have gotten a lot of messages and people saying, “You did great work, we should talk.” I'm just happy. Mississippi is, we have hope again, man, that's the biggest thing. You know, this is my state. What could the Democratic Party learn from the Colom campaign’s digital strategy?  I want to shout out my digital director. Lacy Nelson was the digital director, and she really helped turn things around when it came to just our distribution being able to put stuff out, because at first I was posting, taking pictures, filming, editing, doing everything by myself, and it was the worst headache. You gotta put your feet on the ground, you gotta understand the area in which you are working to try to get voters, and you gotta let them know that you see them and make them feel seen. You have to understand what resonates with people. People in Mississippi are not going to care about the things that somebody who lives in New York City cares about, it's going to be different. And that messaging needs to be different. You can't give Mississippi a New York message. Not that I'm an expert — like I said, this is my first campaign — but I think people should really focus on what that region is listening to. What does Colom’s victory mean for Democrats’ opportunities across the South?  For a long time we’ve looked at it as impossible. And with very little resources, we showed that if you really get out and you do the work, you talk to people, you meet voters where they are, it is possible. Mississippi is one of the hardest places that could have happened. When you look at the investment and you look at what other places have received for that type of thing, it shows that the opportunity was always in Mississippi. … We just needed the investment, and I think that over the years, so many organizations have done the work to get us to this point, and we just seized the opportunity. There's real opportunity in the South. You just gotta invest.

articles.body: <p>La campaña oficial a las elecciones del 29—N arrancó la pasada medianoche con la derecha convencida de obtener la mayoría que tanto ha perseguido y que en 2023 se le escapó en el último momento. El primero de los<i> trackings</i> diarios —una encuesta continua— que 40dB. irá realizando para EL PAÍS y la Cadena SER sitúa a la suma del <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-11-12/feijoo-se-presenta-como-gestor-para-resolver-los-problemas-frente-al-saqueo-de-sanchez.html" target="_blank" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-11-12/feijoo-se-presenta-como-gestor-para-resolver-los-problemas-frente-al-saqueo-de-sanchez.html">PP</a> y <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-12/vox-derogar-tres-normas-por-cada-una-que-se-apruebe-y-militarizar-la-frontera-de-ceuta.html" target="_blank" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-12/vox-derogar-tres-normas-por-cada-una-que-se-apruebe-y-militarizar-la-frontera-de-ceuta.html">Vox</a> en más de la mitad de los votos totales, que le reportarían una mayoría absoluta sobrada: 190 escaños (o 192 contando los dos de Navarra de la coalición UPN-PP), 14 más de los 176 necesarios para no depender de ninguna otra fuerza política. En ese bloque la fuerza emergente es la extrema derecha frente a un PP estancado. De tal modo que las valoraciones ciudadanas del líder de Vox, Santiago Abascal, y del popular Alberto Núñez Feijóo están prácticamente igualadas. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-13/la-campana-arranca-con-la-derecha-en-el-horizonte-de-los-190-escanos.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p><img src="https://imagenes.elpais.com/resizer/v2/6GMU23HZJJA33E6TJ3UUJ52ESI.png?auth=5dcc05206d778f70bbdb639799a4356ced0fc847bb286311db5ba586c14fad3a" width="400" height="400"></img><h3>Informe presentación de resultados</h3><img src="https://imagenes.elpais.com/resizer/v2/EAKG2N7C7FHZZIQSVRLR5RS6XQ.png?auth=aec1776666eac49878127b4f89d0cda0248573ee7ced9764fdd4b9db4864b58d" width="400" height="400"></img><h3>Resultados completos de la encuesta</h3>Accederá a una carpeta con el informe de resultados, cuestionario, los datos con las respuestas individuales y el análisis de cruces, entre otros documentos. articles.body: <p>“Nuestro mayor enemigo es la confianza. Las malditas encuestas que dicen que están todo hecho”, ha advertido a sus seguidores <a href="https://elpais.com/sociedad/2026-11-12/vox-propone-cuotas-para-alumnos-de-otras-culturas-en-las-aulas-y-excluir-a-los-indocumentados-del-sistema-sanitario.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/sociedad/2026-11-12/vox-propone-cuotas-para-alumnos-de-otras-culturas-en-las-aulas-y-excluir-a-los-indocumentados-del-sistema-sanitario.html">el líder de Vox,</a> Santiago Abascal. Tras asegurar que las elecciones del próximo día 29 son “existenciales” para España, ha llamado a la “movilización masiva” ante la cita con las urnas. “Si no logramos librarnos de la peste que gobierna este país, probablemente nuestra patria sufrirá demasiado”, ha advertido. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-13/abascal-advierte-a-sus-votantes-de-que-su-mayor-enemigo-es-el-exceso-de-confianza.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

articles.body: <img src="https://imagenes.elpais.com/resizer/v2/DTVS3LGHPFEEPMBSRYMHHAE57Q.jpg?auth=178f191c615682963f0cd21f4b9947282f6a59ebbf62491fbc9dbfb95756d5aa" width="4176" height="2784" alt="Díaz Ayuso y Núñez Feijóo, este viernes en el acto de Nuevas Generaciones en Madrid."></img><p>La bajada de impuestos, una de las principales banderas del Partido Popular, pierde fuelle. Alberto Núñez Feijóo <a href="https://elpais.com/economia/2026-04-11/los-puntos-debiles-del-infierno-fiscal-que-denuncia-feijoo-cifras-infladas-y-unos-calculos-controvertidos.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/economia/2026-04-11/los-puntos-debiles-del-infierno-fiscal-que-denuncia-feijoo-cifras-infladas-y-unos-calculos-controvertidos.html">ha hablado de “infierno fiscal” bajo el Gobierno de Pedro Sánchez</a> una y otra vez esta legislatura. Pero en el arranque de la campaña electoral, aunque ya había ido lanzando algunos mensajes similares hace unos días, el candidato del PP ha enfriado la posibilidad de acometer una bajada de impuestos si llega al poder, condicionándola al estado de las cuentas públicas. Pese a que implica matizar una promesa que es muy relevante para la derecha, el líder del PP deja claro que, antes de estar en condiciones de bajar los impuestos, necesita conocer cómo están las cuentas, y no cree que gocen de buena salud. “Mi planteamiento es clarísimo, bajar los impuestos. Pero también digo: yo necesito explicar a los españoles cómo es el estado de las cuentas de mi país. No me creo los datos”, ha remarcado este viernes en la entrevista con el <i>youtuber </i>Jordi Wild. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-13/feijoo-pone-en-duda-que-pueda-bajar-los-impuestos-por-el-estado-de-las-cuentas-publicas-no-me-creo-los-datos.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

articles.body: <p>La política económica es una disciplina narrativa, y unas elecciones generales suelen traer giros de guión, más aún si las encuestas apuntan a un cambio de Gobierno. <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-09/el-pp-ampliara-hasta-los-50-anos-de-edad-el-aval-publico-para-pagar-la-entrada-de-una-casa.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-09/el-pp-ampliara-hasta-los-50-anos-de-edad-el-aval-publico-para-pagar-la-entrada-de-una-casa.html">El programa económico del PP</a> propone, básicamente, rebajas de impuestos, un aumento de gasto y el endurecimiento de la política migratoria en un contexto de cierta fatiga de la economía española, agravada por la incertidumbre geopolítica. <a href="https://elpais.com/economia/2026-10-30/espana-crecio-en-el-tercer-trimestre-un-27.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/economia/2026-10-30/espana-crecio-en-el-tercer-trimestre-un-27.html">El PIB crece hoy cerca del 3%</a>, tres veces más que la media europea, y el empleo está en máximos, pero hay malestar por la vivienda y el deterioro del poder adquisitivo, y el ciclo económico va camino de agotarse. Los programas electorales se fabrican para ganar las elecciones y suelen incumplirse con facilidad, pero cuentan una historia: los economistas españoles consultados y los <i>think tanks,</i> los laboratorios de ideas<i> </i>europeos, apuntan que si el programa del PP se cumple España corre serio riesgo de cargarse la disciplina fiscal.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-11-13/expertos-y-think-tanks-ven-riesgos-para-la-disciplina-fiscal-en-el-programa-economico-del-pp.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>
articles.headline: Expertos y ‘think tanks’ ven riesgos para la disciplina fiscal en el programa económico del PP

articles.body: <img src="https://imagenes.elpais.com/resizer/v2/RWEWCHUS6NEOZMQMYISIS33AWI.jpg?auth=61b56aa86e79b9f4ff88f3101572020bd4642fc3c8174d7b4fd2e46c60f41145" width="5319" height="3549" alt="Pedro Sánchez participa en un acto electoral en Pamplona."></img><p>Pedro Sánchez cree firmemente que puede revalidar La Moncloa por mucho que <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-13/la-campana-arranca-con-la-derecha-en-el-horizonte-de-los-190-escanos.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-13/la-campana-arranca-con-la-derecha-en-el-horizonte-de-los-190-escanos.html">las encuestas indiquen lo contrario</a>, pero para que una nueva remontada como la de 2023 se repita necesita movilizar al electorado progresista. Desde los votantes socialistas indecisos y abstencionistas a los desencantados a la izquierda del PSOE, decepcionados por las guerras cainitas cuyo último resultado a escala estatal han sido las candidaturas rivales del Frente Amplio y Podemos. El presidente del Gobierno sabe que un nuevo vuelco en las urnas depende de una reactivación de todo el espacio de la izquierda y del centro moderado no ideologizado que recela de un Ejecutivo de PP con Vox y por eso ha hecho un llamamiento en su primer doblete de la campaña en La Rioja y Navarra a votar el 29-N para que la participación sea del 75%. Si se dan esas condiciones, el candidato socialista confía en que el bloque de izquierdas logre los 176 diputados que dan la mayoría absoluta en el Congreso. El resultado sería un nuevo Gobierno progresista que podría “avanzar más lejos y antes en las conquistas sociales”. Las elecciones generales con la mayor participación fueron las de 1982 (79,97%), en las que Felipe González se impuso con 202 escaños. La participación mínima se produjo en los comicios de 2016 (66,48%), que Mariano Rajoy ganó con 137 diputados. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-13/sanchez-insta-a-una-participacion-del-75-el-29-n-para-reeditar-un-gobierno-progresista-que-llegue-mas-lejos-y-antes-en-las-conquistas-sociales.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p><img src="https://imagenes.elpais.com/resizer/v2/AX7VNANTGZGNBE5ILZU4XKMKL4.jpg?auth=5ae8a614ec4d580d66075f9c85491e18ffedc53b76c9efbbf0b469ec74003e73" width="5494" height="3519" alt="Ambiente del mítin de Pedro Sánchez en Pamplona."></img>
articles.headline: Sánchez insta a una participación del 75% el 29-N para reeditar un Gobierno progresista que llegue “más lejos y antes en las conquistas sociales”

articles.body: <p>El debate cara a cara entre los candidatos a la presidencia del Gobierno de España del PSOE, Pedro Sánchez, y del PP, Alberto Núñez Feijóo, ya tiene fecha confirmada. El encuentro será el próximo jueves 19 de noviembre, aunque todavía no tiene un horario fijado. Estará moderado por la presidenta de la <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-09/el-rechazo-del-pp-a-rtve-complica-el-acuerdo-sobre-los-debates-electorales.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-09/el-rechazo-del-pp-a-rtve-complica-el-acuerdo-sobre-los-debates-electorales.html">Academia de Televisión</a>, María Casado, según ha anunciado este viernes la institución en un comunicado. El cara a cara será el primero de los <a href="https://elpais.com/television/2026-11-11/cuando-son-los-debates-electorales-y-en-que-cadena.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/television/2026-11-11/cuando-son-los-debates-electorales-y-en-que-cadena.html">dos encuentros consensuados</a> entre los candidatos a la presidencia. Aún queda por definirse la fecha para el debate a cuatro. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-13/el-cara-a-cara-entre-pedro-sanchez-y-alberto-nunez-feijoo-sera-el-jueves-19-de-noviembre.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

"></img><p>El PSOE ha presentado una denuncia ante la Fiscalía General del Estado contra el PP y <i>OkDiario</i> tras conocerse que la web pagó los honorarios de la defensa de Koldo García, exasesor del exministro José Luis Ábalos. Los socialistas dan este paso después de que, el pasado 5 de noviembre, la <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-11-05/koldo-garcia-asegura-que-acordo-con-el-abogado-del-pp-un-millon-de-euros-a-cambio-de-informacion-para-hacer-caer-a-sanchez.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-11-05/koldo-garcia-asegura-que-acordo-con-el-abogado-del-pp-un-millon-de-euros-a-cambio-de-informacion-para-hacer-caer-a-sanchez.html">Cadena SER</a> publicara un audio en el que García asegura que acordó con el abogado del PP Alberto Durán el pago de sus gastos de defensa y un millón de euros a cambio de facilitar información que sirviera para hacer caer al presidente Pedro Sánchez. En el audio enviado desde la cárcel, afirmaba que el abono del dinero se realizaría a través de la empresa editora de <i>OkDiario</i>. La ya exabogada del exasesor, Leticia de la Hoz, aportó <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-10-29/la-editora-de-okdiario-pago-242000-euros-para-costear-honorarios-y-gastos-de-la-defensa-de-koldo-garcia.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-10-29/la-editora-de-okdiario-pago-242000-euros-para-costear-honorarios-y-gastos-de-la-defensa-de-koldo-garcia.html">a la Audiencia Nacional dos facturas</a> para acreditar que sus servicios de defensa para García fueron costeados por la web ultraderechista.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-11-13/el-psoe-presenta-una-denuncia-contra-okdiario-y-el-pp-por-los-pagos-de-la-defensa-de-koldo-garcia.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

Se ha construido toda una narrativa contra mí para acusarme de participar en una actividad terrorista”, ha recalcado en la vista celebrada para estudiar su extradición. “Trump obligó a los fiscales federales a que abrieran causas contra todos los opositores, a lo que denomina izquierda radical”, ha remachado su abogado Aitor Martínez. El tribunal debe ahora deliberar y anunciará en los próximos días si acepta la solicitud norteamericana. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-11-13/el-activista-millonario-chambers-contra-ee-uu-y-la-fiscalia-espanola-no-puedo-entender-por-que-estoy-en-prision-desde-julio.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

articles.body: (ACN) Tres dels detinguts pels aldarulls posteriors a la manifestació de la vaga general de l’ 11-N han ingressat a presó provisional comunicada i sense fiança per ordre del tribunal. La causa està oberta per danys, atemptat contra l’autoritat i desordres públics . Els que no han ingressat a la presó han quedat en llibertat a disposició dels jutjats. Aquest divendres han passat a disposició judicial 26 dels 52 arrestats de dimecres i se sumen als 16 que van passar-hi dijous, que també van quedar en llibertat provisional, set dels quals amb mesures cautelars de prohibició d’acudir a manifestacions. Entre tots ells hi ha sis menors d’edat . També et pot interessar Els 110 contenidors cremats durant els aldarulls de la vaga general tenen un cost de 150.000 euros Pablo Mena 1 minut de lectura Alerta Solidària ho considera un abús Alerta Solidària ha explicat que la fiscalia havia demanat la mesura de privació de llibertat per a diverses persones. L’entitat considera un abús i un error greu les peticions de presó. Segons indica, el “discurs repressiu” generat les darreres setmanes i la presó per a aquestes persones són “la resposta del Govern a una situació de forta tensió social que reclama mesures de solució i no pas de repressió “. El col·lectiu anuncia un recurs a l’Audiència Provincial de Barcelona i explica que prepara una resposta “pública i conjunta” els pròxims dies de “totes les parts implicades”.
articles.headline: Presó provisional per a tres detinguts pels aldarulls de la manifestació de l’11-N

articles.body: (ACN) Un home que es va entregar a la policia confessant la mort de la seva parella s’ha suïcidat a la presó , segons ha avançat El Caso i han confirmat a l’ACN fonts penitenciàries. Els fets van tenir lloc al districte de Sant Martí a finals de juliol i l’individu es va presentar en una comissaria dels Mossos d’Esquadra hores després del succés. Havia denunciat la dona per maltractar els fills Posteriorment va transcendir que setmanes abans l’home havia denunciat la dona per maltractar els fills i que, per protegir-los, la fiscalia havia demanat a la justícia que apartés la mare dels menors. El jutjat que va tractar el cas va denegar la petició. Dues setmanes després d’aquesta negativa, l’home va apunyalar la dona al pis on vivia, en presència dels dos nens. També et pot interessar Detingut el presumpte assassí d’un altre crim masclista a Barcelona Redacció 2 minuts de lectura Després del crim, la fiscalia va explicar que el procediment incoat a principis de juliol havia estat per investigar la denúncia de l’home contra la dona per “presumptes episodis de violència exercida per la mare sobre els dos fills menors d’edat”. Per això, en aquell moment no es van investigar “altres formes de violència en l’àmbit de la parella” i la fiscalia només es va orientar a protegir els menors. Des de la detenció a finals de juliol l’home estava en presó provisional . Durant el recompte del matí de dijous, els funcionaris del centre penitenciari l’han trobat mort a la cel·la.
articles.headline: Se suïcida a la presó un home que es va entregar després d’haver assassinat la parella

articles.body: L’onzena jornada del grup cinquè de la Tercera RFEF arriba amb un partit clau per a les aspiracions de dos equips que lluiten per les places de play-off d’ascens. L’Hospitalet i l’Europa B ocupen la part alta de la classificació i s’enfrontaran en un duel que es podrà veure en directe al Twitch de btv esports i en aquesta pàgina web. L’Hospitalet, l’Europa B i les posicions d’ascens El Club Esportiu Europa B i el Centre d’Esports l’Hospitalet es veuran les cares en l’onzena jornada de la Tercera Federació. Els dos equips s’enfrontaran en un partit que ha de servir, per a aquell qui guanyi, per refermar-se en les posicions de play-off d’ascens a la Segona RFEF. L’Europa B és el segon classificat amb 17 punts i a només dos del líder, el Vilanova. El filial escapulat arribarà al partit havent encadenat tres victòries : Cornellà, Atlètic Lleida i Vilanova. Per la seva banda, l’Hospitalet ocupa la sisena posició i té les places de play-off a només un punt. L’equip de Raúl Paje no hi arribarà en el seu millor moment , ja que en les tres últimes jornades disputades només ha sumat dos punts.

articles.body: (ACN) Els maquinistes i Renfe han refet ponts en la reunió del comitè d’empresa que han mantingut aquest divendres a la tarda i han decidit retornar a l’esquema de torns, horaris i estacions d’inici de servei que hi havia fins a l’1 de novembre, dia en què el sindicat SEMAF va decidir trencar tots aquests acords. La decisió d’aquest sindicat va obligar Renfe a establir un quadrant alternatiu en virtut del qual els maquinistes només podien començar la jornada des de l’estació de Sants , un fet que ha comportat alteracions del servei durant tota la setmana perquè alguns dels treballadors no han arribat a temps per agafar el comboi a les primeres hores, en alguns casos, a quarts de cinc de la matinada. En la reunió d’aquest divendres, Renfe i els sindicats representats en el comitè d’empresa, SEMAF inclòs, han decidit fer marxa enrere i tornar al quadrant anterior, una reversió necessària, segons han explicat fonts sindicals a l’ACN, tant per a la plantilla com per als usuaris. També et pot interessar Vaga dels maquinistes de Renfe: Rodalies alerta que s’han complert menys de la meitat dels serveis Marta Casals Torres 1 minut de lectura Així, l’esquema que havia estat vigent fins a l’1 de novembre es tornarà a aplicar a partir de diumenge , segons han confirmat tant Renfe com la banda sindical. A partir d’aquí, ambdues parts s’han citat a més reunions per seguir negociant qüestions relacionades amb les condicions laborals i de seguretat de la plantilla. “Celebrem haver arribat a un acord amb el comitè d’empresa i retornar als acords d’abans del 2 de novembre”, han indicat fonts de Renfe. articles.body: (ACN) L’associació d’advocats Acció Cassandra ha iniciat una campanya massiva de recollida de queixes administratives d’usuaris de Rodalies amb la finalitat d’obrir la via judicial . Segons han detallat en un comunicat, pretenen “convertir el malestar quotidià en reclamacions registrades i construir una base documental per exigir respostes aquí i a Europa ” després de setmanes de denúncia i ofensiva judicial sobre aquest àmbit. L’entitat ha subratllat que vol “deixar constància oficial i jurídica d’un problema greu i sostingut ” que afecta la feina, els estudis, l’economia i la vida personal de milers de persones. Alhora, la iniciativa també pretén reclamar els imports dels bitllets dels passatgers i danys i perjudicis causats per “les deficiències” del servei ferroviari. També et pot interessar Acció Cassandra presenta una querella per l’expulsió dels cantaires de la Sagrada Família Marta Casals Torres 2 minuts de lectura Procés ràpid i senzill Un cop els usuaris hagin presentat les queixes per la via administrativa, i si ni la Generalitat ni el Ministeri de Transports i Mobilitat Sostenible responen en sis mesos, “la reclamació s’entén desestimada —silenci administratiu— i es pot portar al contenciós administratiu”. Es podran recollir reclamacions tant electrònicament com presencialment i és un tràmit gratuït que no requereix advocat . El col·lectiu de lletrats ha facilitat models, instruccions i un generador de documents per fer-ho possible. L’associació ha concretat que la presentació ràpida es pot preparar en uns tres minuts . També et pot interessar Gairebé la meitat d’usuaris habituals de Rodalies s’han plantejat canviar la freqüència d’ús Redaccio Societat 2 minuts de lectura Tot i això, Acció Cassandra ha puntualitzat que generar el justificant “no equival a presentar-lo”, ja que cal signar-lo i registrar-lo a les dues administracions. Posteriorment, la persona afectada ha d’enviar la documentació presentada i els justificants a l’associació d’advocats amb l’apartat Ja he reclamat. La PTP reclama un acord per al finançament La plataforma Promoció del Transport Públic (PTP) ha reclamat al futur Govern espanyol un gran acord polític per garantir la continuïtat de les inversions ferroviàries i establir un finançament estable del transport públic. Davant les eleccions del 29-N , l’entitat reclama l’execució de les actuacions del Pla de Rodalies 2026-2030 i evitar que el canvi d’executiu n’aturi la tramitació, els projectes i les obres. També exigeixen completar el traspàs de Rodalies a la Generalitat “acompanyat del finançament, els trens i el personal necessaris”. articles.body: Cada vegada és més difícil ser atès en català en accions tan quotidianes com anar a un restaurant, fer una gestió mèdica o bé renovar documentació. Així ho demostra l’ informe de l’Observatori de les Discriminacions 2025 , elaborat entre l’Ajuntament i la Taula d’Entitats amb el Servei d’Atenció a Víctimes de Discriminacions ( SAVD ). El 2025, s’han detectat a Barcelona 284 discriminacions al català, mentre que el 2024 se n’havien recollit 192 . Això suposa un creixement del 47,9 % . De fet, aquesta exclusió a la llengua ha escalat posicions : mentre que l’any passat era el cinquè motiu de discriminació a la ciutat, enguany és el segon i només el superen les discriminacions per racisme i xenofòbia . També et pot interessar Les discriminacions per motius de gènere es doblen a Barcelona en un any Marina Segura i Vidal 2 minuts de lectura Per fer-hi front, l’Ajuntament de Barcelona ha posat en marxa diverses accions a escala interna, en l’àmbit empresarial i també en l’educatiu. Per exemple, s’han fet inspeccions del compliment de la normativa de política lingüística a establiments de la Rambla. El racisme i la xenofòbia es mantenen en el podi L’informe ha comptabilitzat 1.265 situacions de discriminació a la ciutat el 2025, que suposen un 14,8 % més que l’any anterior. D’aquestes, el racisme i la xenofòbia continuen sent-ne el motiu principal , amb 348 casos, per vuitè any consecutiu. En aquest sentit, sobretot destaquen les situacions de racisme contra les persones de l’Amèrica Llatina (113) i l’antimusulmà (92). Font: Observatori de les Discriminacions El tercer motiu de discriminació per als barcelonins és la salut, amb 268 incidències, seguida del capacitisme —el prejudici contra les persones amb discapacitat—, amb 232 casos recollits. L’LGTBI-fòbia ocupa el cinquè lloc, amb 228 incidències , i això suposa un pic històric : aquesta xifra s’ha duplicat respecte al 2019, quan les discriminacions al col·lectiu LGTBI van ser 112. L’increment es concentra, sobretot, en la gaifòbia i la transfòbia. D’altra banda, les discriminacions per qüestions de gènere s’han reduït respecte al darrer informe: mentre que el 2024 se’n van comptabilitzar 280, el 2025 se n’han detectat 226. I en el cas de l’aporofòbia —el rebuig a les persones pobres—, les incidències han augmentat de 90 a 141. També et pot interessar Arrels alerta que el 80 % de les persones que viuen al carrer ha patit alguna agressió Maria Solans 1 minut de lectura En paral·lel, el document també mostra com, segons les dades de l’Enquesta de relacions veïnals i convivència (ECAMB 2024), una tercera part dels barcelonins han patit algun tipus de discriminació. Foto: Mònica Riu López (ACN) Augment dels discursos d’odi a les aules L’informe també destaca un augment de discriminacions en l’àmbit escolar . Això es deu a l’increment dels discursos d’odi, actituds discriminatòries i defensa d’ideologies d’extrema dreta entre alumnat i professorat. L’observatori ho explica per la informació que rep l’alumnat a través d’internet, que no té cap escrutini i que els provoca un grau important de desinformació, un augment de la polarització social i el foment de la discriminació i l’odi a grups minoritzats i vulnerables. articles.body: “Confieu en els economistes, que som professionals amb la ment d’un matemàtic, l’ànima d’un poeta i l’ètica d’un sant”. Amb aquest prec a la societat catalana, el degà del Col·legi d’Economistes de Catalunya , Carles Puig de Travy, ha acabat el discurs inaugural de la Jornada dels Economistes d’enguany. En el seu parlament ha radiografiat la situació del país i ha enumerat les condicions que, pels economistes catalans, cal prioritzar per fer avançar l’economia catalana. D’entrada, ha recordat que l’economia creix —un 2,7 % el 2025 i un 2,6 % el 2026—, però que aquest creixement no es tradueix en més prosperitat i benestar per a tothom: “Hem de dir que no arriba a tothom de la mateixa manera”. I per aquest motiu, diu, cal incrementar la productivitat i la competitivitat de les empreses. És a dir, crear més valor per cada hora treballada amb el temps i els recursos disponibles, de manera que es crearien llocs de treball de més qualitat . Això demana modernitzar processos, fer inversions, acostar la recerca a les empreses i fer que la innovació arribi a les pimes. Però per a aquests objectius calen, diu, cinc condicions . 1- Habitatge Més enllà de la qüestió social, diu, l’ habitatge és una infraestructura econòmica : “Condiciona la mobilitat laboral i la capacitat de les empreses per atreure i mantenir el talent”, ha apuntat. En aquest sentit assenyala que la millora dels salaris és necessària, però alerta que cal, sobretot, augmentar l’oferta posant més sòl al mercat, reduint els terminis dels permisos, apostant per rehabilitació i impulsant la col·laboració publicoprivada. Proposa també avaluar, amb dades, les conseqüències de les mesures aplicades sobre l’oferta i els preus. 2- Infraestructures i mobilitat “Necessitem una xarxa de Rodalies fiable i avançar en moltes altres actuacions viàries i ferroviàries que redueixin els colls d’ampolla en diferents parts del país”, ha sentenciat. També ha valorat com a estratègica l’ampliació de l’aeroport del Prat, el corredor mediterrani i els accessos ferroviaris i viaris als ports de Barcelona i Tarragona . 3- Talent En aquest punt, ha situat la formació dual i la col·laboració entre empreses, centres educatius i col·legis professionals com la manera de respondre a la necessitat de professionals qualificats. “Però també ens hem de preguntar si oferim als joves trajectòries professionals estimulants, oportunitats de desenvolupament i salaris d’entrada competitius”, ha reflexionat. “No n’hi ha prou amb formar talent si després no som capaços de retenir-lo”. 4- Administracions A les administracions, els demana que resolguin tràmits amb agilitat i que regulin amb claredat : “Una normativa previsible i que doni seguretat, i que avaluïn si les normes aconsegueixen els resultats que es proposaven”. 5- Accés a l’energia i l’aigua Com a última condició a prioritzar per ajudar les empreses a créixer, Carles Puig de Travy anomena l’accés a l’energia i a l’aigua. Creu que la descarbonització s’ha de fer garantint la seguretat de subministrament i mantenint uns preus que permetin a la indústria “continuar sent competitiva”. Sobre l’aigua, apunta que “exigeix inversions en eficiència, reutilització i regeneració, amb les conduccions i connexions necessàries perquè les instal·lacions puguin funcionar raonablement”. A banda d’aquestes cinc prioritats, Carles Puig de Travy ha considerat que en un entorn de tensions geopolítiques, d’avenç imparable de la intel·ligència artificial i amb un comerç i la cooperació internacional cada cop més incerts, “l’economia catalana té motius per a la confiança”. Però alerta que també hi ha “reptes que exigeixen decisions”.
articles.headline: Les 5 prioritats que assenyalen els economistes per millorar l’economia catalana

articles.body: El Clúster Audiovisual de Catalunya va néixer l’any 2013, impulsat per les empreses d’aquest àmbit, la Generalitat de Catalunya i altres institucions del país, amb la voluntat de dinamitzar i connectar el sector audiovisual i multimèdia, potenciar-ne la competitivitat i convertir Catalunya en un referent internacional al sud d’Europa. Eduard Gil n’és el mànager des del 2016 i durant aquests 10 anys l’entitat i el sector han viscut un gran creixement. Segons les seves dades, actualment a Catalunya tenim més de 4.000 empreses que facturen més de mig milió d’euros a l’any i en la seva totalitat aquest sector mou anualment més de 9.000 milions, una xifra que representa el 2,8 % del PIB català.
